$comment: Art brief for the 8 tapestry cards in frontend/frontend-nextjs/src/components/home/PrivacySection.tsx. All eight are live as of 2026-08-01. To replace one: generate a new image, run it through the resize step below, overwrite frontend/frontend-nextjs/public/images/privacy/<file>, and update the card's `alt` text if the scene changed.
$pipeline: Full-size masters live in frontend/frontend-nextjs/art-masters/privacy (gitignored, never served). Shipped files are 900x672 WebP q80, ~200 KB each, produced with Pillow: im.resize((900, round(900*h/w)), LANCZOS).save(dst, 'WEBP', quality=80, method=6).

output.note: No basePath on this app — reference assets from the site root.

series_consistency.why: The eight cards sit in one grid; they must read as one commissioned set, not eight separate experiments.
rules: Same camera, same lens feel, same raking light from the upper left in every card.
Same fabric border treatment: a visible stitched edge inset from the frame.
Emblem centred, occupying ~55% of the frame height, landscape visible behind it.
Every card uses the shared palette; only the temperature shifts (summer cards cooler, autumn cards warmer).
series_consistency.midjourney: Generate card 01 first, then reuse it as a style reference: append `--sref <url-of-card-01> --sw 100` to cards 02–08. Keep `--ar 4:3 --style raw --s 250 --chaos 0`.
series_consistency.flux_sd: Fix the seed for the series (e.g. 720431) and vary only the subject clause. Use the same sampler/steps for all eight.
series_consistency.dalle: Paste `style_core` + `palette_clause` verbatim at the top of each request, then the card's `subject`.

style_core: macro photograph of a handmade wool tapestry, thick chunky yarn in high relief, couched rope coils laid in contour rows, satin stitch, french knots, turkey-work tufts, individual fibres and a soft fuzzy halo visible on every edge, raking warm sunlight from the upper left casting real shadows in the grooves between strands, matte natural wool with no sheen, shallow depth of field, museum textile-craft photography, tactile and handmade
palette_clause: summer and autumn wool palette only: marigold yellow, golden amber, burnt terracotta, warm coral, deep crimson, dusty plum, olive, sage green, teal, soft sky blue, deep indigo, cream and ecru linen
scene_clause: behind the emblem a stitched landscape: a two-tone sky of horizontal rope rows, a small sun of concentric yarn coils with short ray stitches in the upper right, two cloud puffs made of dense french knots, three layered rolling ridges each combed in a different stitch direction, a hedgerow of knots and a field of upright tufts along the bottom edge, the whole panel bordered by a running-stitch edge
negative_prompt: flat vector art, digital gradient, smooth plastic, glossy, CGI 3d render, clip art, text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, jpeg artifacts, blur, low relief, printed fabric, embroidery patch on white background, human face, photorealistic photograph of a real object
